title: An item that removes or adds a bench pool row keeps pool check green: PLAN's per-kind count is part of its checks
goal: A backlog item whose touches name kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv carries python3 _tools/benchmarks.py pool check among its checks, so a row removed without a replacement (BG-v57estdm, which left kind gap at 4 of 5) is refused at its done, not found red by the next sprint; backlog.py check warns of such an item without that check
